WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.586504 39.248316)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1800 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

```sql
WITH park_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-119.586504, 39.248316), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_values AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, park_point.geom, true))).geom AS contour_line,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, park_point.geom, true))).val AS elevation
  FROM
    park_point,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, park_point.geom)
),
elevation_above_threshold AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Buffer(contour_line, 10000) AS buffered_area
  FROM
    raster_values
  WHERE
    elevation > 1800
),
intersection_distance AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Distance(park_point.geom, buffered_area)) AS min_distance
  FROM
    park_point,
    elevation_above_threshold
)
SELECT
  min_distance AS distance_in_meters
FROM
  intersection_distance;
```
